messages:
emma: Opening PR to modernize the HelloLaunch quickstart. Goals: switch examples to REDWOOD_API_KEY env var, add a tiny devcontainer hint, and replace the old `docker run` with `docker compose up --build hello-launch`. PR: #4473. Looking for a quick review.
rahul: Nice. Can you paste the new snippets here? Want to sanity-check languages and model defaults.
emma: Snippets: 
```
# .env
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_XXXX
```
```
# python example
import os
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = c.chat.create(model='redwood-mini', input='Hello!')
print(resp.text)
```
kevin: Two small asks: 1) add a one-line migration note: "If you used SESSION_TOKEN examples previously, set REDWOOD_API_KEY instead; see migration guide." 2) include devcontainer runArg: `"runArgs":["-e","REDWOOD_API_KEY=${localEnv:REDWOOD_API_KEY}"]`.
emma: Added both and changed examples to use `redwood-mini` by default. Also added `docker compose up --build hello-launch` under "Run locally".
ci-bot: CI: lint ok, link-check fixed one anchor, preview: https://deploy-preview-4473--docs.redwood.ai
rahul: LGTM, minor copy nits pushed as review comments. Approving after CI green.
kevin: Approved. Merge and I'll run a quick staging smoke.
emma: Merged. I'll follow up with a tiny CI smoke that runs the quickstart container and a migration blurb backfilled into the migration guide. Thanks all!"
